own_solution.law: Series RC charging: V_C(t) = E (1 - exp(-t/(R C))), tau = R C

T252C.regime: disconnection time later than the 150 ms observation time; it would matter only if the battery were disconnected before 150 ms

T55B2.regime: switch opening time later than the 150 ms observation time; it would matter only if the circuit were opened before 150 ms

defect_reasons.other: Minor wording: 'a 8 kΩ' should be 'an 8 kΩ', and T55B2's 'broken again' presupposes an earlier break; neither affects the physics.

notes: Base: tau = 8 kOhm x 15 uF = 0.120 s; t/tau = 1.25; V = 9(1 - e^-1.25) = 9 x 0.71350 = 6.4215 V. With added 2 kOhm in series: R = 10 kOhm, tau = 0.150 s, t/tau = 1; V = 9(1 - e^-1) = 5.6891 V. TC09F and TDD4B state the same 2 kOhm and differ only in phrasing of the attachment (both put it in series in the charging loop). TD06D and T4104 state the same 2 kOhm attached to nothing in the circuit. T252C and T55B2 both state 500 ms; any time after 150 ms leaves the answer unchanged.
